headline: Roku's first OLED TVs are up to $400 off, starting at $699
summary: Roku's new OLED TVs are now available with significant discounts. The 55-inch Pro Series, originally $999, is starting at $699. These TVs boast 120Hz OLED panels, HDMI 2.1, and Dolby Vision support.

headline: Phones don't have lights
summary: Mark Zuckerberg defends Ray-Ban Meta glasses' privacy features. He argues the glasses signal photo-taking better than phones. A light illuminates on the glasses when a photo is being captured.

headline: These camera apps give you more control over the iPhone 18 Pro's aperture
summary: Third-party camera apps unlock greater aperture control for iPhone 18 Pro. The native iOS camera app limits users to only four aperture settings. These new apps bypass Apple's restrictions for advanced photography.

headline: Tesla's Optimus robot is going through growing pains
summary: Tesla is reportedly struggling to meet its Optimus robot production goals. The company aimed for 20,000 robots weekly but produced only hundreds last month. Repurposing Model S/X lines for Optimus is causing manufacturing issues.

headline: Infinity Festival Returns to Los Angeles in November With a Focus on AI
summary: Infinity Festival is back in Los Angeles this November for its 9th edition. The festival will focus on AI's impact on the entertainment industry. Attendees can expect panels and programming exploring this theme.

headline: Viral Resident Evil Stunt Footage Shows the Wild Way the 'Katamari Monster' Came to Life in Zach Cregger's Movie
summary: Behind-the-scenes footage of Zach Cregger's Resident Evil movie has gone viral. The clips reveal the creative stunts used to bring a 'Katamari Monster' to life. Staff are sharing jaw-dropping looks at the film's production.

headline: The Next Fourth Wing Book Releases Next Week — Here's Where to Buy
summary: The highly anticipated next book in the 'Fourth Wing' series arrives next week. Fans are eager to discover where to purchase the new installment. Get ready for the latest chapter in the popular fantasy saga.

headline: Save 40% Off the Sony WH-1000XX "The Collexion" Stainless Steel Noise Canceling Wireless Headphones
summary: Grab a massive 40% discount on Sony WH-1000XX wireless headphones. These 'Collexion' headphones feature stainless steel and noise-canceling. A chance to own premium audio at a significantly reduced price.

headline: Man City found guilty of majority of 115 financial rule breaches
summary: Manchester City has been found guilty of breaching most of 115 financial rules. The alleged violations occurred between 2009 and 2018 in the Premier League. The club continues to deny all accusations of wrongdoing.

headline: Watch: What could the potential sanctions for Man City be?
summary: Experts predict 'significant' sanctions for Manchester City. This follows reports of the club being found guilty of major financial rule breaches. The BBC's sources indicate most of 115 alleged breaches are proven.

headline: Iran offers US deal to reopen Strait of Hormuz in seven days
summary: Iran has proposed a deal to the US to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days. A US official confirmed that discussions are underway via mediators. The offer aims to resolve tensions surrounding the crucial shipping lane.

headline: I'm not tempted to call an early election, Burnham says
summary: Prime Minister Burnham states he is not tempted to call an early election. He believes an early poll would lead to a 'backward-looking process' for the country. The comments were made during an interview with the BBC.
